content:
FINAL EXECUTION — MEMBER REGISTRATION COMPLETION

Use ONLY the canonical repository:

GitHub Owner: ibb142
Repository: @[github:https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fibb142%2Fivx-holdings-platform:GitHub Sync - ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform]

Do not create any new repositories, forks, duplicate projects, or temporary branches unless explicitly approved.

Current priority is NOT ownership transfer.
The priority is completing the production member registration flow end-to-end.

Complete the following:

1. Finish Phase 1 Member Registration
- First Name
- Last Name
- Date of Birth
- Gender
- Mobile Phone
- Email
- Password
- Confirm Password
- Profile Photo (optional)

2. Enterprise Validation
- Email format validation
- Phone validation
- Password strength meter
- Duplicate email detection
- Duplicate phone detection
- Clear validation messages
- Prevent invalid submissions

3. Security
- Hash passwords securely.
- Verify authentication flow.
- Rate-limit registration requests.
- Prevent duplicate account creation.
- Verify session creation after signup.

4. Production Integration
- Save every new member correctly in Supabase.
- Verify all required fields persist.
- Verify registration appears immediately in the Members module.
- Verify Owner Dashboard reflects the new member.
- Verify Android, iOS, and Web behave identically.

5. QA
Execute complete end-to-end testing:
- Successful registration
- Existing email rejection
- Existing phone rejection
- Invalid email
- Weak password
- Missing required fields
- Session persistence
- Logout/Login
- Password reset
- Mobile responsiveness

6. Deployment
Commit the completed implementation.
Deploy from the canonical repository only.
Verify GitHub HEAD equals the production Render deployment.
Verify production health after deployment.

7. Final Evidence
Provide:
- Commit SHA
- Files changed
- Tests executed
- Test results
- Deployment ID
- Render health verification
- GitHub/Render SHA parity
- Screenshots of successful registration
- Remaining blockers, if any

Do not report completion without verifiable evidence. Complete the implementation first, then provide proof for every completed item.
